title: Equipment Catalogue
description: The curated Directorate-issue equipment list personnel-scale kids choose from at Kit Issue, instead of SF2E's full item catalogue. Decided 2026-09-09: same real SF2E rules and the same 150cr Step-8 budget (reference/srd/player-core/64-character-creation.json), just a shorter, Directorate-flavoured menu -- players pick freely within it, no further restriction. Every entry's mechanics trace to a real SF2E item via baseItem; the name/flavorNote layer is the only reskin. Singleton file: data/campaign/equipment-catalogue.json.

budget.description: The real SF2E Step 8 rule, restated so a GM running Kit Issue doesn't have to cross-reference the SRD mid-scene.

source.const: Player Core pg. 23, Step 8: Buy Equipment

name.description: The Directorate-issue designation shown to players -- boring and standard on purpose.

baseItem.description: The real SF2E item this is mechanically identical to, for GM/Foundry lookup. Never a reskinned/invented statline.

mechanics.description: Damage die/type, AC bonus, or the item's real effect -- short, factual, no flavor.

flavorNote.description: How Nobu's counter actually presents it: standard-issue, unremarkable, a form number. This is the reskin layer.
